API3: PolicyResponse is a separate DTO and has no Version, internal id or concurrency token. The request DTO does not carry hasClaims. HasClaims is now read from the stored policy and is output-only. No FromBody on a Domain or EF type.

API4: This diff leaves the 64 KB MaxRequestBodySize, the rate limiter and the forwarded-header allowlist unchanged. There is no list endpoint. The new unknown-query filter bounds its work by the Kestrel request-line limit. Rejected keys are echoed only inside application/problem+json, so there is no HTML context.

API8: The diff adds no Development-only or exception-message path. UnexpectedExceptionHandler and Program.cs were not changed, and HSTS and the https-required rejection are still present. The converter's JsonException messages are fixed strings, and Read fails closed.

API9: The only GET route is GET /policies/{reference}, backed by the real service. The F2 diff leaves no canned status or term number. The three canned members (refunds, claims, cancellation) are documented in PolicyMappings.

NET:money: decimal throughout, and a grep for double and float in src found none. TwoDecimalPlacesConverter now writes the InvariantCulture decimal text through WriteRawValue. That text can only contain digits, '-' and '.', so it cannot inject. It no longer rounds, only drops trailing zeros and pads to 2 dp, so no value changes. The Money.Round rule is not violated because nothing rounds.
NET:money: Read accepts only a JSON number. An out-of-range decimal raises a FormatException, which the serializer rethrows as a JsonException, so it is a 400 shape error.

NET:logging: The diff adds no log calls. The existing log calls log only method, path and status, and never personal data or bodies.
